title: Oil below $30
blurb: Crude hits a 12-year low; energy stocks and markets slump to start the year.

title: Brexit vote
blurb: The UK votes to leave the EU. Global markets drop sharply, then recover within weeks.

title: Pokémon Go
blurb: Nintendo's shares nearly double in a fortnight on an app it didn't even make.

title: US election
blurb: Donald Trump wins. Futures plunge overnight, then stocks rally on tax-cut hopes.
credit: Photo: Max Goldberg from USA · CC BY 2.0

title: Amazon buys Whole Foods
blurb: Grocers' shares fall 5–10% in a day on the news. Retail fears 'the Amazon effect'.
credit: Photo: Infrogmation of New Orleans · CC BY-SA 3.0

title: Bitcoin at $19,000
blurb: Crypto mania peaks; a year later Bitcoin is down 80%.

title: Tax cuts signed
blurb: US corporate tax rate cut from 35% to 21%, capping a year of almost uninterrupted gains.

title: Volmageddon
blurb: The VIX doubles in a day and the Dow drops 1,175 points, its biggest points fall ever at the time.
credit: Photo: Carol M. Highsmith · Public domain

title: Trade war begins
blurb: The US announces tariffs on $50bn of Chinese goods; China retaliates.

title: Christmas Eve low
blurb: Rate hikes and trade-war fears drag the S&P 500 almost 20% below its high.

title: Yield curve inverts
blurb: Long-term bond yields fall below short-term ones, a classic recession warning.

title: Aramco IPO
blurb: Saudi Aramco lists as the world's most valuable company at $1.7 trillion.

title: COVID crash
blurb: Markets fall 34% in five weeks. Trading halts four times. The fastest bear market in history.

title: Oil goes negative
blurb: With storage full, a barrel of US crude trades at −$37. Sellers pay buyers to take it.

title: Vaccine day
blurb: Pfizer announces a 90% effective vaccine. Beaten-down sectors surge.
credit: Photo: U.S. Secretary of Defense · Public domain

title: GameStop mania
blurb: Retail traders squeeze hedge funds; meme stocks and crypto boom.

title: Ever Given blocks Suez
blurb: One ship halts 12% of world trade for six days.
credit: Photo: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2021], processed by Pierre Markuse · CC BY 2.0

title: Russia invades Ukraine
blurb: Energy and grain prices spike; European markets fall.

title: Rate hikes begin
blurb: The Fed starts its fastest hiking cycle in 40 years to fight 8% inflation. Stocks and bonds both fall.

title: Bear market low
blurb: The S&P 500 bottoms 25% below its peak; tech stocks are down far more.

title: FTX collapses
blurb: A $32bn crypto exchange goes bankrupt in a week.

title: ChatGPT launches
blurb: A hundred million users in two months. The AI era begins.

title: SVB collapses
blurb: Silicon Valley Bank fails in 48 hours, the largest bank failure since 2008.

title: AI boom
blurb: Nvidia's forecast stunned Wall Street; the AI rally begins in earnest.

title: Nvidia at $2 trillion
blurb: The chipmaker adds a trillion dollars of value in nine months.

title: Yen carry unwind
blurb: Japan's Nikkei drops 12% in a day; a brief global scare.

title: Tariff shock
blurb: Sweeping US tariffs trigger the worst two-day fall since 2020, followed by a sharp rebound.
